correctness.rationale: Direct graph has diameter two. X total-visible iff omitted cells Y hit each same-row and same-column distance-two common-neighbor set, equivalent to at least three distinct opposite-side labels after deleting ANY specified row or column. If Y has a 4-matching, it is feasible; without one König matching-cover implies Y is entirely supported on exactly three rows or columns. Inclusion-minimality of feasible Y then forces degree two in each of these rows, and distinct pair-neighborhoods; transposed similarly. Intersection is exactly bipartite 6-cycles (six per fixed row/column triple). Counting 4-matchings yields 24*C(m,4)*C(n,4), six patterns produce C(m,3)*(b_n)_3+C(n,3)*(b_m)_3-6*C(m,3)*C(n,3). Independently checked direct common-neighbor masks and inclusion maximality for ALL subsets 3x3,3x4,4x4, finding 4x4 coefficients 864 size10 and 24 size12, matching formula. Infinite proof uses König, not finite enumeration.
residual_risks: The independent finite computations have only the stated bounded scope; the general assertions rely on the supplied proofs.
